overview_description.description:
A Saudi-Egyptian startup offering dima©, an Arabic-First Media Monitoring & Social Listening Copilot for Brand Managers, Marketers & PR Professionals at leading agencies & enterprises. The product caters for entities in GCC & MENA who all share a need of Arabic-First and Dialect-Specific Media Monitoring. dima tracks, analyzes, and reports on traditional and social media channels. Popular use cases include: Public Relations, Crisis Management, Market Insights, Influencer Marketing and Competitor Benchmarking.

dima© is trusted by 250+ experts in 8 different countries & counting…Visit our website to learn more and book your demo today!
